steps.title: The Forbidden Fens → first-box spell upgrades
steps.short: The Forbidden Fens → early spell upgrades
steps.note: Build a familiar control/damage toolkit. Firing Drills can move ahead of deeper spells when you mostly autoresolve.

steps.title: Wildlings → Embodiment of the Forest

steps.title: Boszorka’s Wrath → Coven’s Will → Mothers Rally → Folklore
steps.note: Two side skills meet Folklore’s gate. Battle spell Hexes and campaign Hexes are not the same effect category.

steps.title: Firing Drills 3/3 + Creatures of the Land 3/3
steps.short: Firing Drills 3/3 + Creatures of the Land 3/3
steps.note: Reach the useful army upgrades; budget Inspiring Presence first.

steps.title: Evasion → Cursed Cauldron; sustain / veteran skills
steps.note: Follow the four-point spell gate, then the relevant blue and red paths in the notes.

details: Why this order?

Firing Drills is not just a shooting bonus. Its later points also improve the melee defence of Kislevite Warriors, so it supports both halves of your early formation. Creatures of the Land covers the forest animals, Things in the Woods and Incarnate Elementals used here. Wildlings improves eligible forest creatures in her army; it does not improve every human unit. Embodiment of the Forest mixes personal bonuses with army-wide Woodsman. Do not read its forest-battle ammunition bonus as an army-wide effect.
Two different kinds of “Hex”

Boszorka’s Wrath modifies battle spells classified as Hexes. Coven’s Will reduces the Essence cost of campaign Hexes. A cost discount is not the same as automatically advancing an Essence-spending mission.
After the core is working

For frequent auto-resolves, take the blue-line sustain route below. For manual battles, develop the first spell box until its four-point gate opens Evasion , then choose Cursed Cauldron and/or Malediction of Madness . Reach Arcane Conduit through its second four-point gate. Spend on the spells you actually use, not one point in every spell. Ostankya uses the Lore of Hags in the checked tree. Do not follow old mixed-lore skill lists that send her straight to Spirit Leech or Pit of Shades. Skirmisher Traditions supports your veteran human infantry; Ursun’s Favoured supports the eligible veteran beasts. Reach them through Rally! after completing the first red-line gate. It is the units that must be rank 7 or higher.
Shared blue-line path

Route Marcher → four points in the first blue group → Draftmaster → Logistician 3/3 and Quartermaster 3/3 → Renowned & Feared when the second gate is met. Choose useful first-group points for current recruitment, attrition or corruption needs; do not mistake Reassuring Presence for casualty replenishment. Lightning Strike needs all three points to isolate a battle. It is an optional response to enemy reinforcing armies, not an opening tax.
Priority blocks, not a levelling script

A rank gate means the earliest rank at which that node becomes available. The blocks are an order of investment, not an assertion that all listed points fit on that one level. Skip spells already granted at creation. Divert earlier to a favourite spell package when manual battles matter.

steps.short: Taal’s Judgement → Man of the Land → Ambusher

steps.title: Restock! / Taal’s Fury • veteran red skills
steps.short: Restock! / Taal’s Fury • veteran red skills
steps.note: Active abilities are manual-battle tools; do not assume Smart Autoresolve values them equally.

details: Cheap home-defence variant

Keep Firing Drills early. After Taal’s Judgement, favour Man of the People over Ambusher while the army is primarily Warriors and Kossars. Its upkeep reduction applies to those named basic units, not Akshina . Add Man of the Land for replenishment, then the blue economy path.
Do not mistake the mutually exclusive choice

Speaks to the Forest is selected instead of the other rank-10 choices. Its regeneration affects embedded Hag Witch heroes ; Vanguard Deployment is for the Druzhina himself. It is not a whole-army regeneration button. Taal’s Fury needs two of the side skills after Taal’s Judgement. Man of the Land plus Ambusher satisfies that path. Restock! is useful earlier when you manually fight long shooting battles, but is not a prerequisite for this army to work.
Do not budget points for automatic unlocks
The checked tree grants the Druzhina’s Warhorse at rank 8 and Immortality at rank 20 automatically. Their icons appearing in the tree does not mean they need a skill point.
Shared blue-line path

Route Marcher → four points in the first blue group → Draftmaster → Logistician 3/3 and Quartermaster 3/3 → Renowned & Feared when the second gate is met. Choose useful first-group points for current recruitment, attrition or corruption needs; do not mistake Reassuring Presence for casualty replenishment. Lightning Strike needs all three points to isolate a battle. It is an optional response to enemy reinforcing armies, not an opening tax.
Supporting commanders — recommendation, not a confirmed mechanic

A Druzhina-General-led home or support force is a generic-led army: the Druzhina is not Mother Ostankya with a different portrait, does not inherit her personal skill bonuses or spell suite, and no personal-effect carry-over to a supporting commander is asserted as an observed mechanic. Keep a Hag for spells, take the Druzhina's own support skills, and verify any inherited-effect claim on the live panel before relying on it.

steps.note: Develop the action as its next ranks unlock; keep him embedded in the army.

steps.title: Salyak’s Lullaby
steps.note: Prioritise the healing prayer for manual battles, rather than buying every active at once.

steps.title: Personal melee defence and hit points
steps.short: Personal melee defence and hit points
steps.note: Keep the healer alive. Do not send a low-level Patriarch to duel an enemy lord.

steps.title: Healer
steps.note: Choose this specialisation for extra replenishment and a shorter Lullaby cooldown.

steps.title: Finish replenishment and survivability
steps.note: Campaign-map replenishment and healing during a battle are different effects.

steps.title: Damage Walls / Wound / Hinder Replenishment
steps.note: Those are field-agent investments, not the first job of this embedded support hero.

details: Usage notes

Healer is a rank-20 specialisation and blocks the other specialisation choices. In the checked tree it adds to the Replenish Troops action, improves personal hit points and reduces Salyak’s Lullaby’s cooldown. It is not an early-level purchase. Use him near the units that need healing, without exposing him to sustained damage. A healing ability does not restore dead units after a destructive auto-resolve, and the guide does not assume your mod simulates every cast. Only add this hero once your actual recruitment options permit it. The armoured template already reserves a slot; adding one to a different 20-stack means replacing a troop, not making a 21-stack.

ataman.label: Ataman
ataman.title: Governor, not a field commander
ataman.intro: Use the governor slot where stability, trade or an active border makes it valuable.

steps.title: Deploy to the province that needs governing
steps.short: Deploy to the province that needs governing
steps.note: Resource and defensive development can improve Ataman experience. Select the governor’s portrait to spend points.

steps.title: Develop the provincial blue-line benefits
steps.note: Prioritise the displayed Devotion, income or recovery effects for this assignment; do not copy an army lord’s campaign path.

steps.title: Court Sanctioned OR Orthodoxy Adherent
steps.note: Choose the side whose support is lagging or whose next useful boon you are pursuing. These choices exclude each other.

steps.title: Warden OR Ambassador
steps.note: Warden suits a raiding frontier and improves sally reach. Ambassador suits a trading/resource province and diplomatic expansion.

steps.title: Continue the selected support branch
steps.note: Take the branch’s later capacity benefit when the resulting hero is recruitable and useful; no need to race for an unused hero type.

steps.title: Use a safe Garrison Sally Attack
steps.short: Use a safe Garrison Sally Attack
steps.note: Select an eligible settlement to see its attack radius. The garrison returns after the fight; do not mistake this for a roaming extra army.

details: Your limited governor capacity

The rework retains roughly one governor slot per two provinces. Prioritise assignments rather than trying to appoint one everywhere. Move a governor only when the new job outweighs disrupting the old one.
Warden and Ambassador are different commitments

The rank-12 choices exclude each other. Warden is useful where you expect actual sally attacks; Ambassador’s resource and relations benefits fit a protected commercial base. A title is not proof of an army-wide combat buff in every theatre.
Do not build the training estate blindly
The special Ataman training building in the great Kislev cities has economic trade-offs. None of these New World strategies depends on constructing it or conquering Kislev to obtain it.

steps.title: Spell package from the route's default lore
steps.note: The route-selected lore item in this panel is the spell path — Shadows on Routes I and III, Beasts on Route II. Follow its opener, gates and upper-spell order; skip spell points already granted at creation.

steps.title: Evasion
steps.note: Requires four points in the first boxed group of the selected lore; the opener spell alone is not enough.

steps.title: Finish the selected upper path → Magical Reserves → Arcane Conduit
steps.note: Complete the second box's prerequisite with the upper spells you actually use, then invest in sustained casting.

steps.title: Upheaval of Earth
steps.note: Optional bound Assault of Stone bombardment; bring it forward for frequent manual battles.

steps.title: Woodwarden / personal Protective Charms
steps.note: Woodwarden's personal armour from rank 6 and the top-row Protective Charms' personal missile and spell resistance from rank 8 are different skills from the blue attrition-protection action while assisting the army.

steps.title: Automatic unlocks
steps.note: Immortality is automatic at rank 20; its icon in the tree is not a point cost, so do not budget a skill point for it.

details: A caster first, not a general-purpose agent

For an embedded Hag, develop the spells in the selected lore before buying settlement actions. Take Woodwarden from rank 6 when she needs the personal armour, and Upheaval of Earth from rank 10 for its bound Assault of Stone in manual battles. One with Nature is optional local growth, not a replacement for a working spell kit.
There are two “Protective Charms” skills

The top-row skill at rank 8 provides personal missile/spell resistance . The blue action improves attrition protection while assisting the army. Neither is the Patriarch’s casualty-replenishment skill. Buy attrition protection when the route actually needs it. Immortality is automatic at rank 20. Magic, summons and bound attacks remain useful when you fight manually, but the exact way your Smart Autoresolve build values them has not been verified. Keep the army’s health and composition sensible.
One Winds pool
All casters in the army share Winds of Magic. A second Hag supplies another lore, a firing platform and useful support; it does not double your magic budget.
Curse versus blessing

Lore of Hags upgrades can invert a spell into a friendly effect. Read the two versions and save favourite combinations in your notes. The stronger-looking button is not necessarily the right target type.
Damage and protection are different jobs
Use damage magic against valuable dense targets; use protection on the unit actually taking pressure. Thematic casting remains sensible when it buys your army a specific advantage.
Map recovery is not battle healing

Convalescence, Logistician, Man of the Land and a Patriarch’s Replenish Troops support recovery between fights. A Hag’s blue Protective Charms reduces attrition. A prayer or battle regeneration repairs eligible living combatants during the battle, not a deleted unit after autoresolve.
